- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (high sentiment > 0.6) — reduce forecast by 1–2% for 3–5 day horizons.
- Underestimate prices after sharp spikes (e.g., >80) — add 0.5–1.5% buffer to forecast for next 3–7 days.
- Overshoot in early forecast windows (1–7 days) — apply 10–15% downward correction if sentiment is neutral or slightly bearish.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast > 82 for 3+ consecutive days, reduce by 1–3% per day until price stabilizes.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment drops below 0.4 after 3+ days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% per day for 3–5 days.
- Avoid overconfidence in high sentiment + high recent price — cap forecast at 82.5 if sentiment > 0.7 and price > 80.
